description.zh:
应用分组ID。

关于如何获取应用分组ID，请参见[DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the application group.

For information about how to obtain the ID of an application group, see [DescribeMonitorGroups](~~115032~~).

description.zh:
返回结果是否包含阿里云产品的数据接入任务。取值：

- true（默认值）：包含。
- false：不包含。
description.en:
Specifies whether the returned result includes metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services. Valid values:

- true (default): The returned result includes metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services.

- false: The returned result excludes metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services.
The keyword that is used for the search.

description.zh:
指标仓库名称。

关于如何获取指标仓库名称，请参见[DescribeHybridMonitorNamespaceList](~~428880~~)。
description.en:
The name of the namespace.

For information about how to obtain the name of a namespace, see [DescribeHybridMonitorNamespaceList](~~428880~~).

description.zh:
页码。

起始值：1。默认值：1。
description.en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
分页时每页显示的数据行数。

起始值：1。默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
成员ID。

> 仅当您通过管理账号调用本接口删除成员的阿里云数据接入任务（即`TaskType`为`aliyun_fc`）时，需要设置该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the member account.

> This parameter is required only if you use a management account to call this operation to delete the metric import tasks that belong to a member in a resource directory. In this case, the `TaskType` parameter is set to `aliyun_fc`.
The ID of the metric import task.

description.zh:
监控任务类型。取值：

- aliyun_fc：阿里云产品的数据接入任务。
- aliyun_sls：SLS日志的监控项。
description.en:
The type of the metric import task. Valid values:

- aliyun\_fc: metric import tasks for Alibaba Cloud services

- aliyun\_sls: metrics for logs imported from Log Service

title.zh: 查询数据接入任务列表

descriptions.zh: 本文将提供一个示例，查询当前账号下的所有数据接入任务。返回结果显示，当前账号下只有一个数据接入任务`aliyun_task`。
descriptions.en: This topic provides an example on how to query all metric import tasks that belong to the current Alibaba Cloud account. The returned result indicates that the current account has only one metric import task. The metric import task is named `aliyun_task`.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms describe-hybrid-monitor-task-list --keyword task --task-id 360000 --group-id 36070000 --namespace aliyun --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --include-aliyun-task true --task-type aliyun_fc --target-user-id 1208863178610000 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms DescribeHybridMonitorTaskList --region cn-hangzhou --TaskId 360000 --Keyword task --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --TaskType aliyun_fc --IncludeAliyunTask true --Namespace aliyun --GroupId 36070000 --TargetUserId 1208863178610000
